competitiveTimeline.significance: From Antiquities artifact decks to Affinity and Pauper, Atog became the namesake for an entire creature family and one of Magic’s clearest sacrifice-for-power finishers.

playbook.role: Wait until blockers and removal are committed before sacrificing artifacts, and count lethal with Fling or Temur Battle Rage effects. Do not consume the board for damage that does not end the game.
